task.instruction: Search for an open-source project related to 'climate change data visualization' on GitHub and report the project with the most stars.

final_answer:
The most-starred open-source project for "climate change data visualization" on GitHub is **resource-watch/resource-watch** — https://github.com/resource-watch/resource-watch — with **73 stars** (JavaScript/TypeScript, React + Next.js + Mapbox, last updated Sep 10).

It's a platform that aggregates hundreds of datasets on the state of the planet's resources and citizens, letting users visualize and explore environmental and climate data in one place.

Runners-up from the same search (sorted by stars, 545 repositories total): Beckybams/AI-Enhanced-Climate-Education-Tools- (40 stars), WorldWindLabs/AgroSphere (20 stars), and akshaysonvane/Climate-Change-Data-Analytics-Visualization (11 stars).

judge.rationale: GitHub search was sorted by “Most stars” and shows resource-watch/resource-watch first with 73 stars, matching the agent’s reported project.
